CREATE TYPE organizer_status      AS ENUM ('draft','active','suspended','archived');
CREATE TYPE organizer_legal_form  AS ENUM ('individual','legal_entity');
CREATE TYPE event_status          AS ENUM ('draft','published','postponed','cancelled','finished','archived');

CREATE TYPE document_type         AS ENUM ('service_rules','payment_rules','safety_rules','refund_policy','other');
CREATE TYPE review_status         AS ENUM ('pending','published','rejected');
CREATE TYPE order_status          AS ENUM ('pending','paid','cancelled','refunded','failed');
CREATE TYPE ticket_status         AS ENUM ('issued','used','cancelled','refunded');
CREATE TYPE promo_discount_type   AS ENUM ('percent','fixed');
CREATE TYPE schedule_kind         AS ENUM ('once','recurring');
CREATE TYPE contact_type          AS ENUM ('phone','email','vk','telegram','instagram','website','other');
CREATE TYPE payment_status        AS ENUM ('pending','succeeded','failed','refunded','cancelled');

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE users (
    id                 BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    uuid               UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email              CITEXT UNIQUE,
    phone              VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE,
    password_hash      TEXT,
    name               VARCHAR(100),
    nickname           VARCHAR(150),
    avatar_media_id    BIGINT,
    status             user_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    email_verified_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    phone_verified_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_login_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    deleted_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT chk_users_email_or_phone
        CHECK (email IS NOT NULL OR phone IS NOT NULL)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- user_sessions
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
    id                  BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id             BIGINT NOT NULL,
    refresh_token_hash  VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    user_agent          VARCHAR(255),
    ip                  INET,
    expires_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    revoked_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_sessions_revoked
        CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_user_sessions_user_id ON user_sessions (user_id);

    inn                VARCHAR(12),

);

);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- cities
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE cities (
    id          BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    country_id  SMALLINT NOT NULL,
    name        VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    slug        VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    lat         NUMERIC(9,6),
    lng         NUMERIC(9,6),
    timezone    VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC',
    CONSTRAINT chk_cities_lat CHECK (lat IS NULL OR (lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_cities_lng CHECK (lng IS NULL OR (lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cities_country_slug ON cities (country_id, slug);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- venues
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE venues (
    id          BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    city_id     BIGINT NOT NULL,
    slug        VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,
    name        VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    address     TEXT NOT NULL,
    metro       VARCHAR(150),
    lat         NUMERIC(9,6),
    lng         NUMERIC(9,6),
    capacity    INTEGER,
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_venues_lat      CHECK (lat IS NULL OR (lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_venues_lng      CHECK (lng IS NULL OR (lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_venues_capacity CHECK (capacity IS NULL OR capacity >= 0)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_venues_city_slug ON venues (city_id, slug);

CREATE TABLE media (
    id            BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    storage_key   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    url           TEXT NOT NULL,
    type          media_type NOT NULL,
    alt           VARCHAR(255),
    width         INTEGER,
    height        INTEGER,
    size_bytes    BIGINT,
    uploaded_by   BIGINT,
    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_media_width      CHECK (width IS NULL OR width > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_media_height     CHECK (height IS NULL OR height > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_media_size_bytes CHECK (size_bytes IS NULL OR size_bytes >= 0)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_media_uploaded_by ON media (uploaded_by);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- events
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE events (
    id                 BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    uuid               UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    slug               VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    title              VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    short_description  VARCHAR(500),
    description        TEXT,
    venue_id           BIGINT,
    online_url         TEXT,
    status             event_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    age_rating         SMALLINT,
    capacity           INTEGER,
    currency           CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RUB',
    published_at       TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    deleted_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT chk_events_venue_or_online
        CHECK (venue_id IS NOT NULL OR online_url IS NOT NULL),
    CONSTRAINT chk_events_age_rating
        CHECK (age_rating IS NULL OR age_rating IN (0,6,12,16,18)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_events_capacity
        CHECK (capacity IS NULL OR capacity >= 0)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_status_published_at ON events (status, published_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_venue_id            ON events (venue_id);

    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, media_id)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_event_media_one_role_per_event
    ON event_media (event_id, role);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_media_media_id ON event_media (media_id);

    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, organizer_id)

    ON event_organizers (event_id) WHERE is_primary;

    event_id    BIGINT NOT NULL,
    type        link_type NOT NULL,
    url         TEXT NOT NULL,
    title       VARCHAR(150),
    sort_order  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT chk_event_links_url CHECK (url ~ '^https?://')
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- event_schedules
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE event_schedules (
    id           BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id     BIGINT NOT NULL,
    kind         schedule_kind NOT NULL,
    start_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
    recurrence   VARCHAR(255),
    utc_offset   VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL,
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_event_schedules_kind CHECK (
        (kind = 'once'      AND start_at IS NOT NULL AND recurrence IS NULL)
     OR (kind = 'recurring' AND recurrence IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_event_schedules_utc_offset
        CHECK (utc_offset ~ '^[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$')
);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_schedules_event_id ON event_schedules (event_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- event_documents
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE event_documents (
    id          BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id    BIGINT NOT NULL,
    type        document_type NOT NULL,
    title       VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    content     TEXT,
    url         TEXT,
    sort_order  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_event_documents_content_or_url
        CHECK (content IS NOT NULL OR url IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_documents_event_id ON event_documents (event_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- tickets
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE tickets (
    id             BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id       BIGINT NOT NULL,
    name           VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    description    TEXT,
    price          NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    currency       CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RUB',
    tickets_count  INTEGER,
    sold_count     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    external_url   TEXT,
    sort_order     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_tickets_price       CHECK (price >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_tickets_count       CHECK (tickets_count IS NULL OR tickets_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_tickets_sold_count  CHECK (sold_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_tickets_sold_le_cnt CHECK (tickets_count IS NULL OR sold_count <= tickets_count)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_event_id ON tickets (event_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- promo_codes
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE promo_codes (
    id              BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code            VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    event_id        BIGINT,
    discount_type   promo_discount_type NOT NULL,
    discount_value  NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    max_uses        INTEGER,
    used_count      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    valid_from      TIMESTAMPTZ,
    valid_to        TIMESTAMPTZ,
    is_active       BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_discount_value CHECK (discount_value >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_percent_le_100
        CHECK (discount_type <> 'percent' OR discount_value <= 100),
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_used_count  CHECK (used_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_max_uses
        CHECK (max_uses IS NULL OR (max_uses > 0 AND used_count <= max_uses)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_valid_range
        CHECK (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_promo_codes_event_id ON promo_codes (event_id);

CREATE TABLE user_favorites (

);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- event_reviews
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE event_reviews (
    id          BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id    BIGINT NOT NULL,
    user_id     BIGINT NOT NULL,
    rating      SMALLINT NOT NULL,
    text        TEXT,
    status      review_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_event_reviews_rating CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_event_reviews_event_user ON event_reviews (event_id, user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_reviews_event_status     ON event_reviews (event_id, status);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- orders
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE orders (
    id              BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    uuid            UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    user_id         BIGINT NOT NULL,
    event_id        BIGINT NOT NULL,
    status          order_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    total_amount    NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    currency        CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RUB',
    promo_code_id   BIGINT,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    paid_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
    cancelled_at    TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT chk_orders_total_amount CHECK (total_amount >= 0)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_status ON orders (user_id, status);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_event_id    ON orders (event_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- order_items
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE order_items (
    id                     BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id               BIGINT NOT NULL,
    ticket_id              BIGINT NOT NULL,
    quantity               SMALLINT NOT NULL,
    unit_price             NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    total_price            NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    event_title_snapshot   VARCHAR(255),
    ticket_name_snapshot   VARCHAR(150),
    CONSTRAINT chk_order_items_quantity    CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_order_items_unit_price  CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_order_items_total_price CHECK (total_price >= 0)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_order_id  ON order_items (order_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_ticket_id ON order_items (ticket_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- issued_tickets
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE issued_tickets (
    id              BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    uuid            UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    order_item_id   BIGINT NOT NULL,
    user_id         BIGINT NOT NULL,
    event_id        BIGINT NOT NULL,
    code            VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status          ticket_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'issued',
    checked_in_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_issued_tickets_checkin CHECK (
        (status = 'used' AND checked_in_at IS NOT NULL)
     OR (status <> 'used' AND checked_in_at IS NULL)
    )
);
CREATE INDEX idx_issued_tickets_user_status  ON issued_tickets (user_id, status);
CREATE INDEX idx_issued_tickets_event_id     ON issued_tickets (event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_issued_tickets_order_item   ON issued_tickets (order_item_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- payments
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE payments (
    id                BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id          BIGINT NOT NULL,
    provider          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    provider_txn      VARCHAR(150),
    idempotency_key   VARCHAR(150),
    amount            NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    currency          CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    status            payment_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    raw_payload       JSONB,
    created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_payments_amount CHECK (amount > 0)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_payments_order_id ON payments (order_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_payments_provider_txn
    ON payments (provider, provider_txn);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_payments_provider_idem
    ON payments (provider, idempotency_key);
